correctness.rationale: For target diagonal nonzero squares of valuations 2r,2s, the union of (x±z) ideals has valuation min(r,s), except when p=2 and r=s, when it is r+1. The target diagonal weights are c_p p^{-2r}, with c_2=1/8 and c_p=(p-1)/(2p) otherwise. Geometric summation yields exactly 7/372 and the odd-prime rational function; compactness proves the modular-image density limit. Finite enumeration checks, though successful, are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural single-square locus is directly motivated by the square-solvability condition in Jordan Diophantine matrix problems. An exact p-adic probability for every prime gives a complete local invariant with a nontrivial valuation-coincidence correction at 2, and provides the necessary local factor for potential density/sieve computations; global applications are not claimed.
